title: The Standard Model Gauge Group from the Exceptional Jordan Algebra
summary: We construct the Standard Model gauge group using the exceptional Jordan algebra $\mathfrak{h}_3(\mathbb{O})$ and its automorphism group $\text{F}_4$. The group $\text{F}_4$ acts on pairs of Jordan subalgebras $X \subset B \subset \mathfrak{h}_3(\mathbb{O})$ with $X \cong \mathfrak{h}_2(\mathbb{C})$ and $B \cong \mathfrak{h}_3(\mathbb{C})$, and for any such pair the stabilizer of $X$ intersected with the identity component of the stabilizer of $B$ is isomorphic to the Standard Model gauge group.
